##### Project general facts
Najd Seven is a gated villa community developed by Reportage Properties as the concluding chapter of the Najd residential series. The architecture pairs light-coloured facades and framed windows with warm vertical accents, while landscaped walkways link the homes to a shared central courtyard. The collection comprises three-bedroom villas and four-bedroom villas with a maid's room, arranged across several residence types.

Shared amenities include a swimming pool, gymnasium, padel tennis court, barbecue area and mini clubhouse. The central courtyard brings these leisure spaces together, with outdoor seating and landscaping around the homes.

The homes offer three-bedroom and four-bedroom layouts, with a maid room in the four-bedroom collection. Living, private and service spaces are arranged separately. Kitchens come with cabinets, bathrooms have tiled finishes, and the homes include concealed air conditioning, private elevators, smart access, intercom systems, gardens and terraces.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits
Al Aarid is a residential district in northern Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, known for its spacious plots and calm neighbourhood character. The district is framed by King Salman Road to the south, King Fahd Road to the west and Abu Bakr Al Siddiq Road to the east, placing it within easy reach of the main growth corridors of the city. Key destinations in the area include Al Yamamah University, King Abdulaziz Grand Park and King Salman Stadium.

The surrounding road network connects the district with The Avenues Riyadh, King Khalid International Airport and the Riyadh Expo site. Schools, mosques, local shops and healthcare services support daily life, while cafés, restaurants and rest houses add leisure options within the neighbourhood.

Northern Riyadh attracts steady interest from families seeking larger homes in established residential districts. Al Aarid combines this family appeal with proximity to major infrastructure, sports and cultural venues, positioning the area for long-term residential demand.
